definition: Compliance that satisfies the letter of regulation without substantive behavioral change. Includes ethics washing, checkbox governance, and cosmetic safety measures that create an appearance of responsibility while maintaining existing practices.
rationale_for_coinage: Skeptics distinguish performative compliance — theater that reassures without reforming — from genuine adherence. Safetyists use 'compliance' to mean genuine adherence to safety standards. The bare term hides whether compliance is substantive or cosmetic.

do_not_confuse_with.note: Alignment compliance is about AI systems following their intended objectives; performative compliance is about organizations appearing to follow regulations without substance.

contested_aspects: Whether any compliance regime can avoid becoming performative over time
Whether performative compliance is worse than no compliance at all
